senses.gloss: An event that causes a computer or other device to temporarily cease what it was doing and attend to a condition.
However, although, nevertheless, on the other hand (introducing a clause contrary to prior belief or in contrast with the preceding clause or sentence).
Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of that.
(mostly, law) It being the fact that; inasmuch as. (Often used to begin recitals; sometimes emboldened or emphasized as a signifier.)
(countable) A text message sent using the short message service.
For reasons that are easy to understand or sympathise with.
(figurative) Famously and distinctively representative of its type.
Noticeable or attracting attention, especially if unattractive.
Causing a desire to know more; mysterious.
The scientific study of blood and blood-producing organs.
The anterior part of the brain, including the cerebrum, thalamus, and hypothalamus.
In an initial stage; beginning, starting, coming into existence.

(slang, with falling pitch) Used either to belittle the issuer of a statement/question, or sarcastically to indicate utter agreement, and that the statement being responded to is an extreme understatement. The intonation is changed to distinguish between the two meanings - implied dullness for belittlement, and feigned surprise for utter agreement.
A prayer or imprecation that harm may befall someone.
Used to express sorrow, regret, compassion, grief, resignation, or disappointment.
An expression of one's own physical pain.
(uncountable) Driving faster than the legal speed limit.
Speed that exceeds a reasonable or permitted rate.
A device, at least partially mechanical, used to print text by pressing keys that cause type to be impressed through an inked ribbon onto paper.
One’s native land; the place or country in which one dwells; the place where one’s ancestors dwell or dwelt.
The country that one regards as home.
An individual’s place of birth, childhood home, or place of main residence.
A room containing a number of beds (and often some other furniture and/or utilities) for sleeping, often applied to student and backpacker accommodation of this kind.
A large, round, semi-permanent tent with vertical walls and a conical roof, usually associated with Central Asia and Mongolia (where it is known as a ger).
Condensed water falling from a cloud.
A rainy season; monsoon
A sound in speech which has some qualities of a consonant and some qualities of a vowel.
A site for launching spacecraft, usually in reference to such Soviet or Russian built sites as the Baikonur, Kazakhstan and Plesetsk, Russia cosmodromes.
A draft of a law, presented to a legislature for enactment; a proposed or projected law.
A reserved word used to identify a specific command, function, etc.
An area; somewhere within an area.
open space in a town
A town's public square.
A marketplace or other open space in or by a city or town; an esplanade.
The trait of being willing to donate money, resources, or time; generosity, liberality.
A heavy woven cloth, often with decorative pictorial designs, normally hung on walls.

A person attached to a particular pursuit, study, science, or art (such as music or painting), especially one who cultivates any study, interest, taste, or attachment without engaging in it professionally.
A person who is interested in an activity or a subject as a hobby.
(sometimes, derogatory) A person with a general but superficial interest in any art or a branch of knowledge.
Greatly; to a huge extent.
Greatly; hugely; extremely; vastly; to a great extent.
Extremely, greatly: to an enormous degree.
In an imposing manner.
A substance that is harmful or lethal to a living organism when ingested.
An animal toxin intended for defensive or offensive use; a biological poison delivered by bite, sting, etc., to protect an animal or to kill its prey.
A cultural region in West Asia inhabited mostly by the Kurds, encompassing parts of Turkey, Iraq, Iran and Syria.
removal of foreskin from penis
(An example of) Muhammad's way of life, as recorded in the hadiths, especially when viewed as a model for Muslims to emulate.
Including (almost) everything within its scope.
Capable of withstanding great physical force.
Designed to withstand hard usage without breaking; hard-wearing.
In a strong or powerful manner.
Of a problem, that continues over an extended period of time.
(manner) Securely.
Which is not affected or overcome by a disease, drug, chemical or atmospheric agent, extreme of temperature, etc.
(slang) Excellent, brilliant, very exciting, top, great.
Being a part or component of a whole.
Any large wasp of the genus Vespa, having a brown-and-yellow-striped body and the ability to inflict a serious sting.
Being either a rational number, or the limit of a convergent infinite sequence of rational numbers: being one of a set of numbers with a one-to-one correspondence to the points on a line.
An ox-like mammal native to the Himalayas, Mongolia, Myanmar, and Tibet with dark, long, and silky hair, a horse-like tail, and a full, bushy mane.
An insect of the suborder Epiprocta or, more strictly, the infraorder Anisoptera, having four long transparent wings held perpendicular to a long body when perched.
(trademark) An international electronics and media company based in Tokyo, Japan.
Carrying more fat than usual on one's body; plump; not lean or thin.
Of a person: slightly overweight, somewhat fat, and hence plump, rounded, and soft.
Having a full and rounded shape; chubby, somewhat overweight.
Having considerable flesh; plump.
(derogatory) Overweight to the extent of resembling a pig; morbidly obese.
Large in body; fat; overweight.
A person who behaves in a servile or obsequious manner; a toady.
Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing.
What somebody or something is known for.
The process or act of selecting.
(usually, uncountable, computer hardware) Any computer device, including such as a disk, on which data is stored for a longer term than main memory.
The addition of a distinguishing feature to a concept or notion, thus limiting its extent.
The act of disuniting two or more things, or the condition of being separated.
setting apart or separation
A rigid, generally rectangular mounting for paper, canvas or other flexible material.
Any of various small passerine birds, mainly from the genus Anthus, that are often drab, ground feeding insectivores of open country.
Characterised by a dignified sense of seriousness; not cheerful.
A constriction at the muzzle end of a shotgun barrel which affects the spread of the shot.
Causing mild fear.
Causing fear; or capable of causing fear; scary.
Threatening, producing feelings of fear or timidity.
Causing distress; upsetting; distressful.
frightening, especially in appearance.
(in a negative sense) A person who elicits dread or fear; a formidable person.
The act of physically applying or laying on.

A formal written request made by an individual or a group of people to a sovereign or political authority, often containing many signatures, soliciting some grace, right, mercy, or the redress of some wrong or grievance.
(law) Prohibited; not permitted by law (either civil or criminal law; see illegal)
Having super- or preternatural power.
The theory, practice and technology of charting a course for a road vehicle, ship, aircraft, or spaceship.
A stamp used to impress a design on a soft substance such as wax.
An indentation, imprint, or mark made by stamping.
(historical) An object (especially a ring) formerly used to impress a picture into the sealing wax of a document as a proof of its origin.
A seal, signature or signet.
Receiving such care.
Synonym of diarrhea.
medical condition
That causes, or is associated with diarrhea.

Especially, an alignment whereby a planetary object (for example, the Moon) comes between the Sun and another planetary object (for example, the Earth), resulting in a shadow being cast by the middle planetary object onto the other planetary object.

(astronomy) An astronomical event that occurs when one celestial object is hidden by another celestial object that passes between it and the observer when the nearer object appears larger and completely hides the more distant object.
Any of various similar-appearing birds, but usually ground-living, such as the meadowlark and titlark.
(nautical) A short piece of rope spliced to form a circle
One who makes a donation.
A benefactor; someone who donates to charity or some cause.
(rare) Donor, one who donates.
(uncountable) Official language of the people residing on the Korean Peninsula, and language of approximately 60 million people, in Asia, North America, and elsewhere.
Missing one's home and family very much when away; nostalgic.
Any of a group of European plants, genus, Lavandula, of the mint family.
A person or party that is consulted.
One who offers advice.
To create, increase or develop.
To collect normally separate things.
(ergative) To gather as a group.
To collect into a mass or heap.
To assemble again.
A children's game in which the players pretend to be members of a household.
Any dispersion of an originally homogeneous entity, such as a language or culture.
Standing in relation or connection.
someone who takes part in a race
Required, essential, whether logically inescapable or needed in order to achieve a desired result or avoid some penalty.
Gear consisting of a set of articles or tools for a specified purpose.
Absolutely necessary or requisite; that one cannot do without.
Not subject to being alienated, that is, surrendered, taken away, or transferred to another.
A port city, the largest city in Yemen; the former capital of South Yemen.
In an academic style or way; from an academic perspective.
Any of several styles of art, architecture, literature, philosophy, etc., that flourished in the 20th century.
To know how to.
A Northwest Caucasian language spoken in the Russian autonomous republic of Karachay-Cherkessia, in the Caucasus Mountains, as well as in Turkey. [Mid 19th century.]
To disgrace, or bring shame upon.
Having a pleasant melody or sound; tuneful.
Sweet, especially when describing voice or tones; melodious.
(figurative) Sweet, smooth and musical; pleasant to hear (generally used of a person's voice, tone or writing style).
Of sounds, especially speech: demonstrating or possessing euphony; agreeable to the ear; pleasant-sounding.
Characterized by euphony; harmonious.
An assent and engagement by the person on whom a bill of exchange is drawn, to pay it when due according to the terms of the acceptance; the bill of exchange itself when accepted.
Describing a form of an element that exhibits allotropy.
(transitive, often, passive, or, reflexive, with to) To make familiar by use; to cause to accept; to habituate, familiarize, or inure.
(transitive) To cause someone to become accustomed to something that requires prolonged or repeated tolerance of one or more unpleasantries. [from 16th c.]

A calligraphic design that may be read as the same word or phrase (or sometimes different words or phrases) when oriented in two different ways, usually when reflected along a vertical or horizontal axis or when rotated through 180 degrees.
Relating to particles that are constituents of the atom, or are smaller than an atom; such as proton, neutron, electron, etc.
An Old World monkey of the genus Papio, having dog-like muzzles and large canine teeth, cheek pouches, a short tail, and naked callosities on the buttocks.
A term used to characterize a person or thing.
A machine, building, or company used for cutting (milling) lumber or (rarely) other hard materials such as stone.
A moving disturbance, or undulation, in the surface of a fluid.
Possessing or manifesting love for mankind.
A person showing altruism.
The chief magistrate in the republics of Venice and Genoa.
A sort of very large nail.
A container used to carry and dispense water for plants (a watering can).

(Norse mythology) A monstrous wolf, one of Loki's offspring, who bites off Tyr's right hand while being bound by the gods in fear of a prophecy that he will kill Odin, remaining so bound until the events of Ragnarok.
A dish made of melted cheese, or chocolate etc., or of a boiling liquid into which food can be dipped.
A machine that mechanically tills the soil.
A medical doctor specializing in the eye: deficiencies of vision requiring correction, and diseases. Compare optometrist.
animal — see also donkey
A domestic animal, Equus asinus asinus, similar to a horse.
The state or characteristic of being a boor or of being boorish; boorish behaviour.
Something or someone who makes a sound.
(physical sciences) Any of various devices for testing physical conditions, often for remote or underwater locations.
The state or quality of being black in colour.
confection
A hard candy made from butter, brown sugar, syrup and vanilla.
Fit for use or consumption, in accordance with Jewish law (especially relating to food).
A fermented milk drink from the Caucasus and Eastern Europe, similar to yogurt but more liquid.
To make a soft murmuring sound, as a pigeon.
(organic compound) A monoterpene hydrocarbon 1-methyl-4-prop-1-en-2-yl-cyclohexene found in the essential oils of oranges, lemons and similar fruit, and mainly responsible for their fragrance
The surgical procedure to remove all or part of a breast and sometimes nearby tissues.
An instrument consisting of two jaws, closing by a screw, lever, cam, or the like, for holding work, as in filing.
A hand-operated device with rollers, for wringing laundry.
A process by which a task is completed; a way of doing something (followed by the adposition of, to or for before the purpose of the process).
The smallest linguistic unit within a word that can carry a meaning. It may be a letter, a syllable, or otherwise.
Not complete; not finished.
A form of romantic courtship typically between two individuals with the aim of assessing the other's suitability as a partner in an intimate relationship or as a spouse.
To put into a new and improved form or condition; to restore to a former good state, or bring from bad to good; to change from worse to better.
To fasten or attach (something) with a pin.
One who investigates.
Someone who presents a broadcast programme; a compere or master of ceremonies.

A designated space within a church, or a separate room or building associated with a church, where a baptismal font is located, and consequently, where the sacrament of Christian baptism (via aspersion or affusion) is performed.
A local ruler or official in various parts of central and eastern Europe, especially early semi-independent rulers of Transylvania.
A logical arrangement of parts, as in writing.
A cafe or restaurant that serves tea, usually with light food.
The capital city of Lodz Voivodeship, Poland, also spelled Łódź.
